result.title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
result.summary: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .

AI.brief_summary: Cogentic 是面向开放数学与理论计算机科学问题的多智能体证明发现框架，用 orchestrator 分配多个独立证明者探索不同证明方向，经对抗式验证后把确认的中间结果写入持久验证账本供后续轮次使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「验证通过才进入持久账本、后续轮次在此基础上继续」的机制，可能与 LVR 中轨迹训练、贡献分配与证据筛选的监督设计思路相通，可供核查如何把中间推理状态筛选并累积为可信状态；但任务为纯文本证明，无视觉证据与 latent 状态，迁移需较多核查。
